title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Allowance Table — Courtesy Waivers
content:
The courtesy waiver allowances of a Ridgeline Pro Credit account are set by its tier.

| Tier | Courtesy waivers in any rolling 12 months | Largest single charge waivable as a courtesy (USD) | Request window (calendar days after the charge posts) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 1 | 49.00 | 60 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 1 | 49.00 | 60 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 1 | 150.00 | 60 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 2 | 250.00 | 60 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 2 | 500.00 | 60 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 3 | 1000.00 | 60 |

## Reading the allowances

- The count is the number of courtesy waivers of a late fee or late payment charge in any rolling 12 months.
- The largest waivable charge is a ceiling on the charge itself: a larger charge is not waivable at all.
- Hypothetical pair on a Commercial Account Net 30: a late payment charge of 150.00 is within the 150.00 ceiling; one of 150.01 is above it.
